**Repair release. One fix, to the thieves' guild in the sewers.**

## The chests that turned the guild on you

Five chests in the thieves' two secret stashes -- three behind the secret door in the top-left
of the Sewer Main Entrance, two behind the secret door in the Thieves' Congregation -- ran a
hidden Sneak check the moment the loot dropped. Fail it and every thief, guard dog and Juanita
turned hostile, across three maps, permanently, without a word. No line of sight, no distance;
Lockpick did not matter. Every other stash in the game -- the Khan's, the goblins', the
Templar armory -- at least shouts *"Thief!"* first. These did not.

Now they do. Fail the check and a thief shouts *"Oi! Hands off the guild's take!"* before the
guild turns; pass it and *"<Nobody is looking your way.>"* tells you that you got away with
it. Both go to the log. And the guild needs a witness now: if every thief on the map is
already dead, nobody raises the alarm. The check itself is unchanged.

## Installing

Download, unzip, run `Mod Manager.bat`. It installs over any earlier release. The chests take
effect on a character who has not yet entered the sewers.
